items.name: slider
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Slider
items.description: A slider that is a bamboo rake in a tray of sand. Drag right and its four tines cut grooves and push a little heap of sand ahead of it; pull back and its back drags the sand flat again. One file of about 180 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-slider>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-slider value="40" label="Volume"></sand-slider>. Read el.value; it fires input while it moves and change when it comes to rest. min, max and step work; with a name it is sent with its form. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: toggle
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Toggle
items.description: A switch that is a river stone in a tray of raked sand. Switch it on and the stone glides along, parting the sand into a wake, and uncovers a power symbol it had pressed into the sand where it was resting. One file of about 180 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-toggle>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-toggle label="Focus mode"></sand-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: signature
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Signature
items.description: A signature pad of smoothed sand, written in with a stick that cuts like a brush: linger and the line is wide and deep, hurry and it thins. The sand heaps up along the line. Clear sends a rake across that smooths it all away. One file of about 180 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-signature>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Signature is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/signature.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-signature name="signature"></sand-signature>. el.empty, el.undo(), el.clear() and el.toDataURL() give you the signature as ink on a transparent PNG; it fires input after each stroke. With a name its form gets the PNG. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: thinking
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Thinking
items.description: An AI agent's working state as a rock in a round tray of sand that rakes itself. Thinking draws rings round the rock, searching draws spokes, using a tool draws lines that flow round it like water, and writing draws dashes like lines of text. One file of about 380 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-thinking>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Thinking is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/thinking.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-thinking state="thinking"></sand-thinking> and set el.state to thinking, searching, tool, writing or idle as your agent works. It is a status region, so the state is read out. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: checkbox

items.name: rating

items.name: input
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Text Field

Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from its internal input. Supported types are text, email, tel, url and search. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: textarea
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Textarea
items.description: A native multiline textarea over a wider sand tray, with shallow writing grooves and a moving stylus focus cue. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-textarea>.

Read or set el.value; native input and change events bubble from the internal textarea. Rows are clamped from 2 to 10. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: password
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Password Field
items.description: A native password input with a physical Show/Hide stone shutter. The value remains masked by default and is never printed in the demo status text. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-password>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Password Field is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/password.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-password name="password" label="Password" autocomplete="current-password"></sand-password>. Read or set el.value. The revealed property or attribute toggles visibility; password is hidden by default. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: search
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Search Field
items.description: A native search input with a small search well, a clear button, an Enter-to-search event and a moving sand rake while busy. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-search>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Search Field is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/search.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-search name="q" label="Search" placeholder="Search"></sand-search>. Pressing Enter dispatches a bubbling search event with detail.value. Set el.busy=true while your application fetches results; call el.clear() to reset. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: otp
items.title: GrainMotion-UI OTP / PIN Input
items.description: A numeric OTP/PIN input drawn across individual engraved wells. One native input preserves mobile one-time-code autofill, paste, selection and keyboard behavior. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-otp>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI OTP / PIN Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/otp.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-otp name="verificationCode" label="Verification code" length="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" required></sand-otp>. Length is clamped from four to ten. The complete event exposes detail.length only, never the entered digits. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: select
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Select / Dropdown
items.description: A native select control with a floating river stone and a carved chevron. The browser retains its familiar option popup, keyboard navigation and form semantics. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-select>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Select / Dropdown is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/select.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-select name="delivery" label="Delivery speed" options="Standard,Express,Overnight" placeholder="Choose delivery"></sand-select>. Options are comma-separated; use value:Label for distinct submitted values and visible labels. Read or set el.value. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: combobox
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Combobox / Autocomplete
items.description: A native text input connected to a datalist for browser-managed suggestions. It permits free text, keyboard entry and paste while a small rake follows the query. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-combobox>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Combobox / Autocomplete is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/combobox.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-combobox name="city" label="City" options="DEL:Delhi,BLR:Bengaluru,HYD:Hyderabad" placeholder="Start typing"></sand-combobox>. The browser provides the datalist suggestion UI. Read or set el.value; free text is allowed. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: date-picker
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Date Picker
items.description: A native date input over an engraved sand calendar. The value remains an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date string, with min, max and unavailable-day validation that avoids local timezone conversions. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-date-picker>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Date Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/date-picker.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-date-picker name="startDate" label="Start date" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31" unavailable="2026-12-25"></sand-date-picker>. The value uses YYYY-MM-DD and is not converted through the local timezone. The native date picker handles calendar keyboard interaction. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: date-range
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Date Range Picker
items.description: Two native date fields represent an inclusive calendar range. The component validates order, required endpoints, min/max bounds and unavailable days; it serializes complete ranges as start/end ISO strings. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-date-range>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Date Range Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/date-range.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-date-range name="stay" start="2026-11-21" end="2026-11-25" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31"></sand-date-range>. The value is `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD`; start and end are separate properties. Dates are compared as calendar days, not local timestamps. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: time-picker
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Time Picker
items.description: A native time input paired with a circular sand dial and deterministic 12/24-hour readout. Values remain timezone-free HH:MM strings; min, max and step use native time constraints. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-time-picker>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Time Picker is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/time-picker.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-time-picker name="appointment" label="Appointment time" format="12" min="09:00" max="17:30" step="900"></sand-time-picker>. Read or set el.value in 24-hour `HH:MM` form. The `format` property controls a 12/24-hour readout; native input presentation follows browser locale. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: progress
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Progress Bar
items.description: A bamboo rake advances through a sand channel, leaving a growing trail and a soft ridge ahead of its tines. Supports determinate and indeterminate progress. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-progress>.

items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Progress Bar is a plain script that registers a custom element. Set value, min and max; add indeterminate for unknown progress. The element exposes progressbar semantics and aria-valuetext. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Progress Ring
items.description: A circular progress indicator with a river pebble travelling around an engraved sand groove. Supports determinate and indeterminate states. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-progress-ring>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Progress Ring is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/progress-ring.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-progress-ring value="68" label="Processing"></sand-progress-ring>. Set value, min and max, or add indeterminate for a looping marker. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: steps
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Step Indicator
items.description: A multi-step indicator using stepping stones and native buttons. Completed, current and upcoming steps are visually distinct and keyboard operable. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-steps>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Step Indicator is a plain script that registers a custom element. Read or set value as a zero-based active step index. The element submits that index when name is supplied. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: timer
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Hourglass Timer
items.description: A countdown timer rendered as a two-chamber hourglass. Sand falls through a narrow waist; pause, resume, reset and cancel controls remain native buttons. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-timer>.

Load /grainmotion-ui/timer.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-timer duration="90" label="Break timer"></sand-timer>. Call start(), pause(), reset() or cancel(); read remaining and listen for timer-tick and complete. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: loader
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Loading Indicator
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator with a miniature rake that loops through a recognizable sand pattern, distinct from the AI Thinking state. One file of about 30 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-loader>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Loading Indicator is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/loader.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-loader label="Loading results"></sand-loader>. Set active=false when work completes and speed to adjust the animation rate. Reduced motion holds the rake still. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: tabs
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Tabs

Put template[data-panel] elements inside for real panel content. Read or set value and listen for the bubbling change event. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: accordion
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Accordion
items.description: An accordion made from walnut lids with small stone pulls. Opening a lid reveals a sand-toned compartment containing preserved native HTML content. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-accordion>.

Add multiple for simultaneous panels and collapsible to allow all panels to close. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: pagination
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Pagination
items.description: A pagination control with numbered sand wells and a moving river-stone page marker. Page state and navigation are native buttons; data loading remains the host application's responsibility. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-pagination>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Pagination is a plain script that registers a custom element. Read or set page, configure sibling-count and boundary-count, and listen for change to load the selected page. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb navigation trail with real ancestor links and a non-interactive current page marker. River stones sit along a shallow raked path. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-breadcrumbs>.

Supply semicolon-separated Label|URL ancestors and a plain current label, or assign the items array property. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: menu
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Menu / Popover
items.description: A compact command menu with a lifting stone trigger, anchored walnut tray, keyboard navigation, outside dismissal and focus restoration. Commands are emitted as events for the host application. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-menu>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Menu / Popover is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/menu.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-menu items="new:New project,duplicate:Duplicate"></sand-menu>. Listen for the bubbling select event to run an action. The open property and attribute control the menu visibility. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: dropzone
items.title: GrainMotion-UI File Dropzone
items.description: A file dropzone with real drag-and-drop and native file selection, type and size checks, clearable file state and accessible rejection messages. A file tile settles into a sand tray when accepted. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-dropzone>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI File Dropzone is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/dropzone.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-dropzone accept="image/*,.pdf" multiple max-size="10485760" label="Project files"></sand-dropzone>. Read files, call addFiles() or clear(), and listen for files-change and file-reject. max-size is in bytes; the component selects files but does not upload them. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: upload-queue
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Upload Queue
items.description: A transport-agnostic upload queue with per-file progress, queued/uploading/complete/error/cancelled states, retry and removal controls. It emits requests so the host application can perform the actual transfer. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-upload-queue>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Upload Queue is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/upload-queue.js with a script tag (not a module), Use <sand-upload-queue label="Uploads"></sand-upload-queue>. Call addFiles(files), update(id, {status, progress, error}), remove(id) or clear(). Listen for upload-request, upload-cancel, retry-request and queue-change. The host application owns the network transfer. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: carousel
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Image Carousel
items.description: An image carousel that displays real images in a recessed walnut frame with previous/next buttons, indexed selection, touch swipes and keyboard navigation. It never fetches or transforms image sources. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-carousel>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Image Carousel is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/carousel.js with a script tag (not a module), Set el.items to an array of {src, alt, caption} objects. Read or set el.index and listen for change. Only HTTP(S), blob and data:image sources are accepted. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: lightbox
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Lightbox Gallery

items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Lightbox Gallery is a plain script that registers a custom element. items.name: scrubber

The scrubber does not fetch media; it reads duration/currentTime/buffered and writes currentTime when seeking. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: color-picker
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Color Picker
items.description: A color control with the native browser color dialog and a palette of tactile mineral swatches. Supports hexadecimal, RGB and HSL readouts plus form submission. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-color-picker>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>

items.name: sortable
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Sortable List
items.description: A reorderable list with native drag-and-drop, keyboard shortcuts and explicit move buttons. Ordering is stored as stable item IDs and exposed through a property and events. items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Sortable List is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/sortable.js with a script tag (not a module), Set items to an array of {id,label,disabled} objects. Read value for the ordered IDs or call move(fromIndex,toIndex). Native dragging, arrow keys and Move Up/Down buttons are supported. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Transfer List
items.description: A two-sided transfer control with multi-selection, explicit move-selected and move-all actions, and stable item IDs. The host owns the data and persistence. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-transfer-list>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Transfer List is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/transfer-list.js with a script tag (not a module), Set items to {id,label,side,disabled} objects. Select IDs through the selected property, then call move(ids,'left'|'right'), moveSelected(target) or moveAll(target). More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: split-pane
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Split Pane
items.description: A two-pane horizontal or vertical layout with a pointer-draggable separator, keyboard resizing, minimum and maximum bounds, and slotted host content. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-split-pane>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Split Pane is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/split-pane.js with a script tag (not a module), Place child elements in slot="start" and slot="end". Set value as the first pane percentage, axis to horizontal or vertical, and configure min-size/max-size. Listen for input and change. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: resizable
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Resizable Panels
items.description: A multi-panel layout with two to four panels, adjacent resizable boundaries, keyboard controls, minimum and maximum proportions, and serializable panel sizes. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-resizable>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Resizable Panels is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/resizable.js with a script tag (not a module), Assign panels as an array of {id,label,content,min,max} objects. Read or set sizes as percentages and call resizeBoundary(index,delta) to adjust an adjacent pair. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: tree
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Tree View
items.description: A nested tree with expansion state, single-node selection, visible-node keyboard navigation and accessible treeitem semantics. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-tree>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Tree View is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/tree.js with a script tag (not a module), Assign nested items with id, label and children. Read or set value and expanded, or call select(id) and toggle(id). Arrow keys navigate and expand/collapse branches. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: tooltip
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Tooltip
items.description: A non-interactive tooltip anchored to a trigger by element ID, with pointer and keyboard activation, Escape dismissal, configurable placement and delay, and aria-describedby token preservation. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-tooltip>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Tooltip is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/tooltip.js with a script tag (not a module), Use the for attribute to reference a trigger element ID and text for the hint. Set placement and delay, or read/write open and call show() or hide(). More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: toast
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Toast Notification
items.description: A timed notification with status or alert semantics, action and dismiss controls, timer pausing on hover/focus, and independent corner stacking. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-toast>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Toast Notification is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), Call show(message?) and dismiss(reason?) or set open. Configure title, message, tone, duration, position and action-label. Listen for action and dismiss events. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: alert
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Alert Banner
items.description: A persistent status banner with tone-aware live-region semantics, optional title, action and dismissal. It stays visible until the host or user dismisses it. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-alert>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Alert Banner is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/alert.js with a script tag (not a module), Set tone, title, message, dismissible and action-label. Call dismiss() or show(), and listen for action and dismiss events. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: dialog
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Dialog / Modal
items.description: A native modal dialog custom element that preserves caller content, traps focus through the browser top layer, supports Escape and optional backdrop dismissal, and restores opener focus. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-dialog>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Dialog / Modal is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/dialog.js with a script tag (not a module), Set open or call showModal()/show(). Use close(returnValue), title, description, confirm-label, cancel-label and dismissal policy attributes. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: drawer
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Drawer / Sheet
items.description: A responsive modal sheet that slides from the left, right, top or bottom, uses native dialog focus containment, and provides Escape/backdrop and action controls. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-drawer>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Drawer / Sheet is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/drawer.js with a script tag (not a module), Set open or call showModal()/show(). Configure placement, size, title and description; close(returnValue) and listen for drawer-open, drawer-close and confirm. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: command
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Command Palette
items.description: A keyboard-first searchable command palette with native modal focus containment, filtering, active result navigation and host-facing command events. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-command>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Command Palette is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/command.js with a script tag (not a module), Set commands to records with id, label, description, keywords, shortcut and disabled. Call show(), hide(reason) or run(id); read value and listen for command, select, command-open and command-close. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: context-menu
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Context Menu
items.description: A context menu anchored to a target element or built-in demo surface, opened by right-click, long-press or keyboard shortcut, with viewport-aware positioning and keyboard navigation. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-context-menu>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Context Menu is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/context-menu.js with a script tag (not a module), Set items to action records and optionally set the for attribute to a target ID. Listen for menu-open, select/menu-select and menu-close. The host executes the selected action. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: filter-builder
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Filter Builder
items.description: A structured filter editor with configurable fields, operators and values, AND/OR logic, add/remove/reset operations and a serializable query contract. One file of about 40 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-filter-builder>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Filter Builder is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/filter-builder.js with a script tag (not a module), Set fields and filters as properties, select AND or OR through logic, and listen for input, change, apply and reset. toQuery() returns the host-facing query object. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: table
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Data Table
items.description: A searchable, sortable and selectable data table with stable row IDs, column visibility, multi-selection, sticky headings and bounded client-side pagination. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-table>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Data Table is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/table.js with a script tag (not a module), Set columns and rows as properties; read selected, page and pageSize. Set filter, sortBy and sortDirection, call sort(key), select(id, checked), selectVisible(ids, checked) and listen for sort, filter, select, change and row-activate. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI

items.name: kanban
items.title: GrainMotion-UI Kanban Board
items.description: A multi-column Kanban board with stable card and column IDs, native drag-and-drop, explicit move buttons, arrow-key movement, priority labels and host-facing move/select events. One file of about 50 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-kanban>.
items.author: Brajesh Kumar <https://github.com/Brajesh31>
items.docs: GrainMotion-UI Kanban Board is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /grainmotion-ui/kanban.js with a script tag (not a module), Set columns to records containing id, label and cards. Call moveCard(cardId, columnId, index) or action(cardId, direction); listen for move, change and select events. More: https://brajesh31.github.io/GrainMotion-UI
